{{Top|leg}}
The '''Historic District''' was one of the two regions of the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. It was part of the original fort settlement on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]] and housed the governmental buildings and corporate offices.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
